I shipped step 1 of the art build as cw-helmbar, v28.79 (commit 3620a47c). The Heavy helmet no longer has the neon bar. It now has a low steel ridge on top. The scheme accent shows only as a small lens on the brow, with an ink housing and a white glint.

The check draws the helmet offscreen on the Toxic scheme and counts pixels. No accent column may be taller than 4.5 px, and at least 20 accent pixels must remain so the lens is still there. The gate passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

The ship had been blocked by an orphan 28.79 check left in `tools/mkfixture.ps1` by the failed cw-fewerguns ship. Another worker dropped it in commit 166ea6d5, so I only had to ship again.

I didn't start step 2 (ink outline and hue ramps on the player body). `notes/art.md` now lists the remaining steps in brief order, and the next ship number is 28.80.

TASK DONE
